Modeled on well_page.resource's own prior "Apply Well Navigator" precedent and Equipment's "Apply Equipment Navigator" (pageobjects/.../Equipment_Objects/equipment_page.resource) per-field-group pattern: reads ${properties_path} (one line per group, in FILE ORDER — the keys, e.g. "G:1", are free-form documentation only, NOT resolved by DOM lookup), fills nav:form:G:<n>:R:1:C:0 for n = 1, 2, 3, 4 in that order via the shared T1 "Set Navigator Filter" (resources/navigator.resource), then clicks GO ("Apply Navigator") exactly ONCE at the end. Group 5 ('Well') is deliberately NEVER filled — it is scan-flagged mandatory (CSS) but offers zero usable options under every scope tried (confirmed by the pre-existing driver py/well_bore_iud.py); GO succeeds anyway and the grid loads on 4 levels. This keyword lives entirely in well_bore_page.resource — resources/manage_object.resource is NOT touched by this conversion.

Converted to the full Area-pattern 5-TC/per-TC-login/pure-screen-verify STRUCTURE (owner standing rule 2026-08-26: any EC screen with a navigator matching Area's layout MUST follow Area's FULL pattern) - Well Bore remains OV-GM and still needs its genuine 4-level PER-FIELD navigator + GO and its genuine mandatory Well popup; this is a structural conversion, not a change to either mechanism. Uses a FIXED test code (AUTOTEST_WB) rather than a generated/timestamped code - confirmed absent from OV_WELL_BORE (2026-08-27, fresh oracledb connection) before this was wired in. Every run must complete TC05 (delete) so the code is free for the next run.
